info.title: LeadGen Pipeline API
info.summary: Internal HTTP API for the local lead-gen & auto-site pipeline.
info.description:
## Introduction

This is the HTTP API behind the **Local Lead-Gen & Auto-Site** dashboard. It turns a city + niche into paying website-hosting clients: scrape Google Maps for local businesses, auto-build a personalized demo site for each, deploy it to a subdomain, and reach the prospect by email / SMS / DM.

The API is **internal** — it powers the operator dashboard. There is no public developer program. Use this reference to understand the endpoints the dashboard calls, to script ad-hoc batch re-runs, and to integrate webhooks.

## Base URL

All paths are relative to your deployment origin. In this reference, requests sent with **“Send Request”** go to the **same origin** as the page you're viewing (the live deployment). For local development the base is `http://localhost:3000`.

## Response envelope

Every JSON endpoint returns a uniform envelope:

```json
// success
{ "success": true, "data": { } }

// failure
{ "success": false, "error": "human-readable message" }
```

`data` shape varies per endpoint and is documented per-operation. The only non-JSON endpoint is `GET /api/batches/{id}/export`, which streams a CSV file.

## Errors

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `400` | Bad request — invalid or missing fields |
| `404` | Resource not found |
| `409` | Conflict — e.g. a one-time form link was already used |
| `422` | Validation failed — body/query failed the zod schema |
| `500` | Unhandled server error (still returns the `{ success:false, error }` envelope) |
| `503` | Database not configured — `SUPABASE_URL` / `SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY` are missing |

## Authentication

> **There is no public API-key or bearer-token auth today.** Endpoints are served by the Next.js app and gated only by the app's own deployment + Supabase service configuration. Treat every write endpoint as privileged and do not expose this deployment publicly. The 3 genuinely public endpoints (no DB needed, no auth) are: `GET /api/pricing/*`, `POST /api/form/{token}` (token *is* the credential), and the `POST /api/webhooks/*` receivers (validated by the provider).

## Paid external calls

Several endpoints spend money (scraping, AI copy, deploys, email/SMS). They are flagged **💰 paid** in their description. Don't loop them in scripts without checking cost first.

## Lead lifecycle (`leads.stage`)

`scraped → enriched → generated → deployed → outreached → replied → meeting_booked → meeting_done → improved → handed_over → closed_won | closed_lost | dead`. `needs_email` is a side-state when outreach has no email.

Pure function — no DB, no paid calls. Safe to call as the user types.

post.description: Creates a batch row with `status='queued'` and returns a cost preview. `template_slug` is derived from the niche server-side (override optional). 💰 Running it later spends scraper credit.
Returns 202 immediately and dispatches scraping to a Cloud Run job (falls back to in-process). 💰 Spends scraper credit.

get.description: Aggregated funnel + conversion + cost for the batch. No paid calls.
Streams a CSV file (not the JSON envelope) for handoff to a dialer. `Content-Disposition: attachment`.

post.description: Creates a `source='manual'` lead and joins the import batch.
Parses CSV text, maps columns, validates + normalizes phones, dedupes by phone, inserts under one import batch.

get.summary: Count reachable leads for a channel (+ sample)
get.description: Powers the New Campaign wizard preview. Returns the eligible pool count and up to 50 sample leads. Pure read.

patch.description: All fields optional. Setting `call_segment` derives the offer pair + locks the lead; setting `primary_offer` alone also locks it.

example.notes: Spoke 6/16 — wants photos of the new van.

post.description: Runs enrich → generate → deploy (stages 2–4). Gated to the 5 focus niches. 💰 Gemini copy + Cloudflare deploy. Returns 202.

parameters.name: refresh-photos
parameters.description: Clear the photo cache and re-pick.

post.summary: Re-run the pipeline from a stage
post.description: 💰 May spend Gemini/Cloudflare depending on `from_stage`. Returns 202.
Re-generates the site with real photos / copy / hours after a meeting. 💰 Gemini + Cloudflare. Returns 202.
Soft no-op ($0) until a sending mailbox is configured.
Soft no-op ($0) until the SMS provider key is configured. 💰 When live.
Records the event and advances the stage to `outreached` if applicable. No automation.
Threads to the latest message and clears the needs-reply flag. Operator 1:1 — bypasses the daily cap, honors the global kill switch.

post.summary: Hand the site to the customer
post.description: `attach` adds the customer's domain to our Cloudflare Pages project and returns DNS instructions. `transfer` records intent only (manual handoff in the Cloudflare dashboard).
Returns `needs_email` if the lead has no email. 💰 When an email provider is wired.
`enroll` starts the 4-step progressive-trust sequence; `stop` halts it; `recapture` re-shoots the screenshot (Cloud Run, returns 202).
Explicit `lead_ids` win; otherwise an app-source `target_count` auto-selects. Status starts `active`.

post.summary: Send pending email members (within the daily cap)
post.description: Honors the kill switch + warmup-ramped cap; stops when the cap or kill switch is hit. SMS/DM campaigns use the queue instead. 💰 Sends real email.
Uses the real campaign email, `[TEST]`-prefixed. Bypasses the cap, writes no outreach row. 💰 One email.
Fetches new mail from every active mailbox, matches to leads, logs events, classifies replies (bounce/unsubscribe/human/auto). Read-only on the provider, $0. Safe on a cron.
Verifies SMTP hard (400 on failure), IMAP soft (warning on failure). Initializes warmup ramping.

post.summary: Send a test email from a mailbox
post.description: Proves the SMTP path works. Bypasses the cap, writes no outreach row. 💰 One email.

parameters.name: token

post.description: Atomically claims the link (409 if replayed) and lands the lead in the inbox.

post.summary: Verify the whole table (Cloud Run job)
post.description: No body. Returns 503 if GCP env is not configured. 💰 Email-verification credits.
Quick path for the UI. Heavy batches use the Cloud Run job. 💰 Email-verification credits.
Opens / replies / bounces. On reply, advances the lead to `replied` and stops the sequence; on bounce, stops the sequence.
Stub for billing — signature verification + handlers to be wired when billing goes live.

GenericData.description: Success envelope with an endpoint-specific `data` object.

Estimate.description: Full cost preview: a one-time scrape cost plus a per-qualifying-lead build cost (Gemini copy + any photo resolution). Pure function — no paid calls.

effective_limit.description: After per-scraper caps. Apify (default) has no hard cap — a 300 safety cap applies; Outscraper=500; Places=60.

estimated_qualifying.description: Leads expected to pass qualification — drives the build subtotal.

scrape.description: Stage-1 lead-list scrape cost, charged once per batch.

build.description: Per-qualifying-lead site-build cost, charged when you build a site (not at batch creation).

breakdown.description: Flat list of every cost line (back-compat).

free_credit_consumed_usd.description: Portion drawn from Google's $200/mo credit — non-zero only for the google_places scraper.

template_slug.description: Optional override; derived from the niche otherwise.

Lead.description: A scraped or imported business. Many DB columns exist; the important ones are shown.

target_count.description: App-source auto-select size (ignored if lead_ids given).

DispatchResponse.description: Returned by long-running endpoints that dispatch to Cloud Run (HTTP 202).

operation.description: GCP operation name when dispatched to Cloud Run.
